label: the letters 'ze' right after a 'De' (any case) that starts a word with NO space before it: after '(', a quote, a line break or at the very start, as in (Dezeen), "Deze", Dutch 'Deze week' at a sentence start, DEZE-44. Quiet when a space comes before it (' Dezeen' mid-sentence, ' deze'), and for Dezember, Dezi, Deza, bronze, dozen. Weak (~0.3) on French 'tenu'.

notes: Step-out feeder of bonsai1/L34/N11316- (stream crawl from bonsai1/L25/N8045+). play step ran out of GPU memory, so the feeder was taken by rank: it is the top MLP feeder by attribution on the resident model (chat feeders tool). The - pole is small (max 3.6, gate-closed leak regime); its tops are 'ze' in 'Dezeen' after '(' or a line break; French 'tenu' / Spanish 'Atentamente' sit near 0.3. The + pole is a strong 'detention' detector. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only; the solver's leak and near-miss lines were placed by that author.

edges.method: attribution rank 1 of 12 MLP feeders on the target's top 4 examples (resident feeders tool; play step ablation hit CUDA OOM)
